installer-gui-script.title: Anthill Appliance
installer-gui-script.welcome:
This configures this Mac as an always-on Anthill org backend:
- it never sleeps and restarts after a power cut, - it runs the dashboard for your team on the local network, and - on Apple Silicon it can also train the org model on-device.
Install the Anthill app first if you have not. For the GPU to stay available after a reboot, enable auto-login for this user (System Settings -> Users & Groups -> Login Options).
